# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, using GitHub private vulnerability
reporting:

<https://github.com/BearingQuest/project-template/security/advisories/new>

Please don't open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability.

This is a personal project run by one person. I read every report, but I can't
promise a response time.

## Supported version

Only the code on `main` is supported. There are no releases and no older
versions to patch.

## Scope

In scope:

- The package in `src/project_template/`.
- The workflows and other configuration in this repository.

Out of scope:

- GitHub itself. Report problems there to GitHub.
